national_news.title: Stock Markets Decline Due to Spike in Crude Oil Prices
bullets: The BSE Sensex and NSE Nifty declined in early trade due to a spike in crude oil prices amid geopolitical uncertainties.
Brent crude traded 1.03% higher at $84.41 per barrel, with elevated crude prices remaining a key risk.
Foreign Institutional Investors (FIIs) bought equities worth ₹480.24 crore on Friday, with the market undertone being mildly bullish due to better-than-expected Q1 results.
